    • join

      public DataBuffer join(List<? extends DataBuffer> dataBuffers)
      Return a new DataBuffer composed of the dataBuffers elements joined together. Depending on the implementation, the returned buffer may be a single buffer containing all data of the provided buffers, or it may be a true composite that contains references to the buffers.

      注意，给定的数据缓冲区不需要释放，因为它们会作为返回的复合对象的一部分被释放。

      此实现使用了 Netty 的CompositeByteBuf。

      Specified by:
      `join` 在接口 `DataBufferFactory` 中
      Parameters:
      dataBuffers - 要组合的数据缓冲区
      Returns:
      一个由 `dataBuffers` 参数组成的缓冲区

    • toByteBuf

      public static io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf toByteBuf(DataBuffer dataBuffer)
      Return the given Netty DataBuffer as a ByteBuf.

      如果 `dataBuffer` 是 `NettyDataBuffer`，则返回其原生缓冲区；否则返回Unpooled.wrappedBuffer(ByteBuffer)。

      Parameters:
      dataBuffer - 要返回 ByteBuf 的 DataBuffer
      Returns:
      Netty 的ByteBuf
